name: Fezzerk
backstory:
__notoc__

Fezzerk leads a gang of goblins at Blighted Village in Act One, tormenting an unfortunate deep gnome as part of the Rescue the Gnome quest. Depending on whether he is spared, he can make a minor appearance in Act Two.
